image_description: A close-up view of a Nile crocodile resting on a reddish-brown bank at the water's edge. The head and upper torso are visible, showing textured, armored skin with osteoderms. The mouth is closed, revealing interlocking teeth along the jawline. The eye is visible with a vertical pupil. The background consists of dark water with reflections.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is broad and triangular with a V-shaped snout (narrower than alligator).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The snout tapers distinctly towards the nostrils, consistent with the V-shape of a crocodile rather than the U-shape of an alligator.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Jaws are massive with numerous conical, interlocking teeth visible when mouth is closed.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Multiple conical teeth are clearly visible protruding from the lower jaw even though the mouth is closed, indicating the characteristic interlocking arrangement.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are positioned dorsally on the head with vertical slit pupils and a nictitating membrane.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The eye is located on the top ridge of the skull. A vertical slit pupil is discernible. The nictitating membrane is not clearly deployed but the position is correct.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Nostrils are positioned at the tip of the snout.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Nostrils are clearly visible at the anterior end of the snout.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is elongated and heavily armored.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible portion of the body shows heavy armor plating and extends out of frame, implying elongation.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is covered in thick, bony scutes (osteoderms) arranged in regular longitudinal rows along the dorsal surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Distinct, raised bony plates (scutes) are visible in organized rows along the back and neck.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Scutes are dark brown to grey with a rough, heavily textured appearance.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The coloration is olive-green/brown with a highly detailed, rough texture consistent with reptile skin.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ventral surface is covered in smooth, rectangular scales that are pale yellow to white.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The belly/ventral side is completely occluded by the angle of the photo and the ground.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are short and stout with webbed feet; forelimbs have five digits, hind limbs have four.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: No limbs or feet are visible in this specific crop/frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and muscular, comprising half of total body length.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is not visible in the frame.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The water ripples immediately adjacent to the snout appear slightly 'smudged' or painterly, lacking the crisp specular highlights expected in a high-resolution photograph. There is minor bleeding between the chin and the water line.

While teeth are present, the geometry of the lower jaw teeth seems slightly irregular in spacing and size compared to the perfect biological symmetry usually seen. Some teeth appear to merge slightly with the gum line.
